443:t_2:107.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Thus the $$イボルバー$$... the humans who would later come to be called the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ set out for the galaxy.」

443:t_2:108.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The humans who remained decided to relocate to the Moon and the colonies until the environment recovered.」

443:t_2:109.en:
$$ハリー$$
「So those were the ancestors of the $$ムーンレィス$$ and the $$宇宙革命軍$$?」

443:t_2:110.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But even after that, humanity remained divided. Some forcibly descended to Earth and chose to live inside domes with a controlled environment...」

443:t_2:111.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Others chose to live in places like the high latitudes, where the pollution was relatively light, until the environment recovered.」

443:t_2:112.en:
$$ランド$$
(So he's talking about those guys...)

443:t_2:113.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Furthermore, apart from the $$イボルバー$$, there were also those who ventured out into the galaxy while remaining human. They are the ancestors of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

443:t_2:114.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So that's the truth of the $$黒歴史$$...」

443:t_2:115.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're something else, $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$. Even asleep, you know Earth's current state so well.」

443:t_2:116.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I get this information from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s $$ヴェーダ$$.」

443:t_2:118.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Do you have access rights to $$ヴェーダ$$!?」

443:t_2:119.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「We were built for the same purpose. That is why we share a common code.」

443:t_2:120.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ and this $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ have the same purpose...」

443:t_2:121.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Could it be that the reason the $$サテライトキャノン$$ worked in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ was...!」

443:t_2:122.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. The code sent out by the $$ガンダム$$ you pilot also uses a part of it.」

443:t_2:123.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$ must have sensed it and activated the necessary system for you.」

443:t_2:124.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well, that's a shock. So old man $$イオリア$$ knew about parallel worlds even before the $$時空震動|lc$$ ever happened?」

443:t_2:125.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「And to think this facility and $$ヴェーダ$$ have a system in common...」

443:t_2:126.en:
$$刹那$$
「There are other things that exist across parallel worlds...」

443:t_2:128.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. $$クロノ$$ is connected to how I came to be built.」

443:t_2:129.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But the one who built $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ was...」

443:t_2:130.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...Yes. It was my ancestor.」

443:t_2:132.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Yes... It seems the $$ソレル$$ family was a member of an organization called $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_2:134.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「By the time I became the Moon Queen, the existence of $$クロノ$$ had already lost its meaning.」

443:t_2:135.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Therefore I know it by name only, and I do not know what purpose they were working toward.」

443:t_2:137.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Yes... And what I tell you from here on is the truth of the $$黒歴史$$ in the true sense...」

443:t_2:139.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The darkness of the $$黒歴史$$...」

443:t_2:141.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I never thought the day would come when I would speak of this. That is why I did not touch on it in our earlier talk.」

443:t_2:142.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But knowing the current state of Earth, I cannot avoid telling you this truth.」

443:t_2:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it does involve $$クロノ$$ after all...」

443:t_2:144.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「To explain that, I must first speak of the truth of the $$月光蝶$$.」

443:t_2:148.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The $$月光蝶$$ is said to have tried to bury civilization with a dispersal of nanomachines that could be called indiscriminate, in order to end the war of that era.」

443:t_2:149.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are you saying that's not true!?」

443:t_2:150.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It is true that there was such an aspect.」

443:t_2:151.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「But there was a hidden intent: humanity had to cast off its civilization once.」

443:t_2:152.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What in the world for!?」

443:t_2:153.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That is precisely the will of $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_2:155.en:
$$タケル$$
「So they destroyed civilization to stop evolution...」

443:t_2:156.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. Not only that, they feared Newtypes as the seeds of evolution.」

443:t_2:157.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It is absurd, but I imagine they did not even understand what it meant, and simply took people with abilities to be the form evolution takes.」

443:t_2:159.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「There is no need for such a sad face, $$ティファ$$. Not knowing the truth, they unwittingly gave me eternity, one of the forms evolution can take.」

443:t_2:161.en:
$$カレン$$
「What do you mean, $$キリコ$$?」

443:t_2:162.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I've felt it since we arrived, but this place is similar to 《$$ワイズマン#keyword$$》.」

443:t_2:163.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「The superhumans who ruled the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy from the shadows...」

443:t_2:164.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「The ones who transferred their minds into machines and gained eternity, huh?」

443:t_2:165.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Indeed... You could say they and I are the same kind of being.」

443:t_2:166.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That is what I am as this $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$. Thanks to that, I am able to speak with you like this.」

443:t_2:167.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「And so they built this facility on the Moon. As their duty as $$クロノ$$.」

443:t_2:168.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Did this place hold some meaning?」

443:t_2:169.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「The Moon is the closest celestial body to humanity, after all. That is exactly why there is meaning in reaching it.」

443:t_2:170.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The meaning of humanity going out into space...」

443:t_2:171.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「That's right. The $$ラプラスの箱$$ of the $$宇宙世紀$$ was likewise born from the Moon.」

443:t_2:173.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$... What exactly was there on the Moon?」

443:t_2:175.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless have no need to know that.」

443:t_2:178.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This explosion...! Is $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ under attack!?」

443:t_2:180.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「I'm sorry... I am unable to tell you the truth...」

443:t_2:181.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「It seems my time has come to enter eternal sleep as well...」

443:t_2:182.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We'll find the truth ourselves! So don't worry about it!」

443:t_2:184.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「There is no need to grieve, $$ティファ$$... Now I, too, will be freed from living on forever...」

443:t_2:185.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Death... That, too, is a right granted to living things.」

443:t_2:186.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even dying is a right...」

443:t_2:187.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Life is beautiful because it is finite...」

443:t_2:188.en:
$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$
「Having done what I was meant to do... I can... end my life... This is... a happy... thing... you know...」

ソレル.evidence: Family name of Dianna Soreil (glossary: ディアナ・ソレル = Dianna Soreil); ソレル家 = the Soreil family. No standalone ソレル token in the sheet.
